name: morning-brief
title: Morning Brief
mission: Keep track of my loose ends: promises I made, things I am waiting on, deadlines and meetings. Each morning, tell me what needs attention today.
schema_md:
# How this wiki is organised

- `projects/<slug>`: one page per project or area of work. Open loops (things to do, things I am waiting on) live here.
- `people/<slug>`: one page per person I deal with: what they owe me and what I owe them.
- `events/<slug>`: meetings and deadlines worth preparing for.

Item kinds: `loop` (an open task or promise), `fact` (something true worth remembering), `person` (who someone is), `event` (a dated happening).

Close a loop only when a source says it is done. Prefer updating an existing item over adding a near-duplicate.
